entries.summary: Implemented per-user GitHub video segmentation with per-course repos. Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{slug}. Each lesson is a folder within that repo.
entries.details: New model: GitHubAccount (user, github_username, github_token). Removed repo_name field - now auto-generated per course. API: GET/POST/DELETE /courses/github/ + GET /courses/{id}/github/. Video upload now uses user's GitHub token with per-course repos. Auto-creates repo if not exists. Frontend: GitHubConnect.tsx component.
decisions: Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{course-slug}
Each lesson is a folder: lesson-{id}-{title}
Token verified via GitHub API before saving
If no GitHub connected, saves locally only
